jobs.tierReason: owner-only bulk ledger state change; Opus review in train 4
jobs.prompt:
Add an owner-only bulk supersede command for stale tickets, with a dry-run, to Project Swarm. Work in tools/scope-commands.mjs (CLI dispatch), tools/tickets.mjs (status model), and a new tests/tickets-supersede.test.mjs. Tests first for the new behavior, then implement.

Command shape: `swarm tickets supersede --before <date> [--dry-run] [--yes] [--stage S]`.
- Owner-only: refuse with a clear message when the process is an agent session (`process.env.CLAUDECODE` or `process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT` set) unless `process.env.SWARM_OWNER === '1'` (an explicit owner override for tests/automation). An owner terminal is allowed.
- --before is required; parse it with Date.parse; refuse an unparseable date. Selection: tickets whose LAST TOUCH is strictly before --before, in the active statuses proposed, todo, ready and blocked only (never running, review, done, cancelled). Optional --stage narrows by stage.
- Last touch: the maximum `at` timestamp among `.swarm/project/tickets.log` events that carry that ticket id (any event), falling back to the ledger's `createdAt` when a ticket has no event (show which basis was used per ticket in the dry-run).
- Dry-run (and the default with no --yes): print one row per candidate: id, current status, stage, last-touch date, basis (log or ledger-created), title; then a count line; write NOTHING. Add `--json` support: an array of {id,status,stage,lastTouch,basis,title}. Without --yes or --dry-run, print the same list and 'Rerun with --yes to supersede these tickets.' with exit code 0? Use exit code 1 only for errors, 0 for the listing.
- Apply with --yes: take the wave lock with the existing `withLock` helper, RE-READ the ledger inside the lock, recompute the candidate set, set each ticket status to the new terminal status `superseded`, write once with `writeLedger`, append ONE log event `{event:'supersede-stale', by:'owner', before, count, ids, source:'tickets-supersede', actor: ticketActor()}`, then `refreshPlan(root)`. Print the count. If the fresh set is empty, say so and write nothing.
- Status model: add `superseded` to STATUSES; add it as a legal move from proposed, todo, ready and blocked; terminal like cancelled/done (no exits). Do not let running/review reach it. Keep every existing status behavior and validation intact.
- Do not create a scope change order and do not touch the scope approval state; this is a ticket-ledger owner action, journaled in tickets.log.

Tests: create tests/tickets-supersede.test.mjs covering: dry-run lists and writes nothing (ledger and log unchanged); --yes only changes stale active tickets and leaves running/review/done/cancelled alone; log-based last touch vs ledger-created fallback; agent session refused without SWARM_OWNER, allowed with SWARM_OWNER=1; invalid/missing --before refused; superseded is terminal and counted in ledgerStats; one appendLog event with the count. Reuse the fixture/helpers style in tests/scope-commands.test.mjs (read it).

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/tickets-supersede.test.mjs -> all pass. Report exact commands and counts.
